Boundary: a study counts under every design its full text names (upper bound); closed-set word classifiers without a recognition-to-text route are outside; versions once.

read_fulltext.quote:
The trained acoustic model was used together with a trigram BN
language model for decoding.

Each phoneme is modeled using a 3-state left-to-right Hidden Markov Model (beginning, middle, and end
of the phoneme), silence is modeled by a single state.
Average Copy Task decoding performance in the final 5 evaluation sessions had a word error rate of 2.5% (95% CI, 2.0% to 3.1%)
per minute and median word error rate of 25%
